messages:
nina: RFC follow-up: We need a clear tenant-aware upgrade flow for FP8/INT8/4-bit precision profiles. primary goals: preserve exact-pin behavior, allow safe shimming, and make rollouts auditable.

ash: +1. Root cause we saw in last rollout was a customer pinned to a profile digest but runtime accepted a newer schema and applied a subtle rescale. silent regressions are killer.

praveen: proposal sketch: every profile artifact gets a tiny compat header (schema_id, compat_mode, created_iso, checksum, author). Runtimes must check header and consult tenant policy before applying any shim.

praveen: header mock (json block):
```json
{"schema_id":201,"compat_mode":"shim","created_iso":"2026-03-22T21:00:00Z","checksum":"sha256:ff12...","author":"ml-team"}
```

zoe: tenant policy model:
- pinned: require byte-for-byte checksum match; reject otherwise.
- allow-shim: allow shim path but emit audit event.
- permissive: runtime picks best-effort profile.

nina: operational controls: must include an immediate kill-switch to mark a profile as "disabled" and route traffic to the last-known-good variant. also need an opt-out flag per-tenant stored in account metadata.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary for profile schema_id=201 -> dedicated-eu-west-1, 0.2% traffic (job id: canary-201-eu).

ash: perf note: shim adds ~1.8ms p50 for seq=64 on A10G in our bench. for p95 it can be ~5ms. real cost depends on whether we do extra dequant/req-normalize. add to catalog.

praveen: quality gate idea: compute a composite degradation metric (logprob shift + token swap-rate + embedding-cosine-drop). thresholds: block if composite >0.035 for strict tenants. Shadow-run new profiles across a sampled prompt corpus for 7 days before canary.

zoe: API boundary: runtime select_profile(request_meta, tenant_policy, profile_header) -> (decision_code, shim_plan, reason). decision_code in {ACCEPT, SHIM_APPLIED, REJECT}. keep it minimal.

nina: audit trail: record per-request if shim applied and include profile checksum and shim_plan id. retain samples for 30 days.

praveen: migration steps: 1) publish profile as preview and shadow for 7d; 2) run tiny canary 0.1-0.5% for 24-48h; 3) expand 1% -> 10% if metrics stable; 4) full rollout opt-in for permissive tenants, strict tenants unchanged unless they opt in.

ash: add a per-route flag `prefer_no_shim` for latency-sensitive routes. runtime respects route-level overrides over tenant-level permissive settings.

zoe: action items: praveen -> write proto schema & small shim prototype; ash -> add perf numbers to catalog and instrument shim latency; nina -> ops doc: canary steps, kill-switch, tenant opt-out handling; zoe -> draft alert rules for degradation metric. schedule 30m sync Thurs.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary-201-eu started, results ETA ~2h.
